newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's CPP '96 div 80 esc vs 90 '95.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's CPP '96 div 80 esc vs 90 '95.

text.p: Portuguese bank Banco Credito Predial, a unit of Banco Totta e Acores, said it approved at a general shareholders' meeting the distribution of a net dividend of 80 escudos per share for 1996, compared with 90 in 1995.
The general meeting on Wednesday approved a capital increase by two billion escudos to 30 billion via incorporation from reserves.
On March 6, CPP announced a consolidated net profit for 1996 of 4.075 billion escudos, up from 3.889 billion in 1995.
